Subject: Pilot request: private/VPC evaluation for Mediq Health

Hi Rishi,

We self-registered for a private pilot via your site this morning (Mediq Health) — thanks for making the self-serve option available. We're evaluating Redwood for handling PHI workloads and would like to schedule a short pilot demo focused on Private/VPC deployment and security controls.

High-level asks:
- Confirmation that on-prem / VPC options can support our data residency and tenant isolation requirements.
- Walkthrough of audit logs, KMS integration, and SOC2 controls.
- A quick ops-runbook overview: firewall & network prerequisites.

Preferred windows (US/Eastern):
- Tues 2027-12-13: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 2027-12-14: 09:00–11:00

I'll loop in procurement once we have a time. Attaching a short systems footprint doc (Mediq_RFC_footprint.pdf) with our environment and a compliance contact: compliance@mediqhealth.com.

Thanks —
Caroline Hayes
Director of Technical Programs
Mediq Health

We can absolutely cover VPC/on-prem options and the compliance controls you listed. A couple quick checks before we lock a slot:

- Who should be on the invite from your side (security, procurement, infra)?

Proposed demo slots (all ET):
1) Tue 2027-12-13 10:00–11:00 (fits your first pick)
2) Tue 2027-12-13 15:00–16:00
3) Wed 2027-12-14 09:00–10:00 (we can extend to 11:00 if needed)

If you confirm slot #1, we can schedule an optional 20-min preflight with our SE (cc'd Soojin) the day before to review firewall IPs and the audit-log retention matrix.

Thanks — I'll hold 10:00 on our side for now pending confirmation.

— Rishi

Hi Caroline — looking forward to the session. Quick tech preflight notes so your infra/security folks know what to expect:

Preflight (recommended topics) — 20 minutes on Mon 2027-12-12:
- Public IPs to allow (we'll provide a list of 4 IPs for the demo gateway)
- TLS termination + client certs (if you require mTLS for management plane)
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS/HSM). We'll need key ARN or key id for the pilot if you want encryption-in-use validation.
- Audit logs: default retention 90 days, can be configured per-account; format is JSON lines with token-level metadata.
- Resource constraints: expected memory/CPU footprint for a 2-node pilot (I looked at your footprint doc).

If procurement wants the scope of the pilot in writing, I can attach a short mutual action plan (MAP) after we lock the time. Also linking our private deploy runbook for quick reference: https://drive.redwood.com/private-deploy-runbook

Proposed preflight times (ET) on Mon 12/12: 09:00 or 16:00 — which works for James/Amy?

— Soojin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
